[LFST.7.6.1] This scenario does not arise: the cache is
**per-engine engine state** ([LSTO.4.7]), not a store
shared across tiers. Cross-tier cache influence
reaches a lower engine as a **recorded input** (a
trace / inbox write, [LSTO.4.7.3] / [LTIE.5]), so
there are no concurrent writers to one shared key and no
storage-backend-observed order to depend on. The
determinism below is therefore structural, not a property
of a storage adapter.
